_comment: 🔮️ Pinned third-party physics-oracle toolchain for the 🔋️energy plugin, provisioned by the sibling `📜️script.ts oracle setup` into `.🧬semio/🦑️repo/⚡️cache/oracles/<tool>-<version>-<platform>/`. Every archive is verified against the sha256 recorded here (the digest GitHub's own release API reports for that asset), so a corrupted or substituted download fails closed. TEST-ONLY: nothing under this package is reachable from any shipped semio artifact.

tools._binariesComment: 🗂️ The OpenStudio archive's bundled EnergyPlus omits `WeatherData/`, `ExampleFiles/` and `PostProcess/ReadVarsESO` — the annual weather year is committed as a fixture instead and results are read from the SQLite output, so `energyplus -r` is never used.

python.reason: 🐍️ The `openstudio` bindings are a compiled SWIG wrapper whose Windows wheel matrix stops at cp313; 3.12 is the widest common denominator across the macOS/Linux/Windows wheels and is pinned in `pyproject.toml` so `uv sync` downloads it without touching the repository's own 3.14 interpreter.
